question.en: Discuss the significance of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) in shaping the modern global trading system.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) in shaping the modern global trading system.

structure.en: Introduction to GATT and its origin.
structure.hi: Introduction to GATT and its origin.

structure.en: Transition to WTO and its impact.
structure.hi: Transition to WTO and its impact.

introduction.en: GATT was established in 1947 as a multilateral agreement to regulate international trade, aiming to reduce tariffs and other trade barriers after World War II.
introduction.hi: GATT was established in 1947 as a multilateral agreement to regulate international trade, aiming to reduce tariffs and other trade barriers after World War II.

body.en: GATT introduced core principles like Most Favored Nation (MFN) and National Treatment, which prevented discriminatory trade practices. Through eight rounds of negotiations, it successfully lowered average tariffs on industrial goods. However, its lack of institutional status and weak dispute settlement mechanism led to the Uruguay Round, which culminated in the creation of the WTO in 1995, providing a more robust legal framework.

conclusion.en: GATT laid the foundation for the current rules-based global trading system, fostering unprecedented growth in international trade and economic integration.

valueAddition.en: GATT started with 23 founding members and grew significantly over its 48-year existence.
